title: Cryogenic quantum error correction
tagline: Cryogenic circuitry for quantum error correction.
description: Cryogenic circuitry for quantum error correction. The related CryoZip work studies syndrome compression in 22 nm FDSOI characterized at 4 K; its reported power, performance, and area results are analysis results, not measurements of this chip.

publications.title: CryoZip: An Efficient Cryogenic Compressor for Quantum Error Correction Syndromes
